title: NIST WebBook: Butane is C4H10, molecular weight 58.1222 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Butane as C4H10, molecular weight 58.1222 amu, CAS 106-97-8.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Butane, CAS Registry Number 106-97-8, lists molecular formula C4H10 and molecular weight 58.1222 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 58.0782503 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C4H10/c1-3-4-2/h3-4H2,1-2H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
